limitations: The source cohort belonged to the previously opened V2.0 holdout.
This is independent of V2.2 development selection but is not an untouched blind holdout.
After the first legitimate inactive longer-duration offer stopped V2.3, V2.3A restarted from zero and restricted the primary comparison to 15 minutes.
The unchanged thresholds apply only to the complete 15-minute primary comparison; 30- and 60-minute offers are descriptive coverage only.
Mechanism-family prevalence is outside this validation stage.

protocol_amendment.reason: V2.3 stopped when a legitimate inactive longer-duration offer was incorrectly treated as an execution failure

resource_policy.gpu_reason: OpenDSS three-phase power flow uses the CPU path

selection_design.rule: within each feeder-call_time cell, select the smallest and largest scenario suffix from the prior V2.0 holdout cohort; no outcome field used
